chunks.head: make up one's mind
chunks.note: 本章为被动式 one's mind was made up = 主意已定、决心已下。make up 在此指“下定、拿定”，非“化妆/编造”。

literal.note_cn: make up one's mind 的被动形式

chunks.ex_en: She made up her mind to become a doctor.
chunks.ex_cn: 她下定决心要当医生。

chunks.head: get along
chunks.note: 本章指“(在生活里)过得去、勉强度日”；另一常见义是 get along with sb = 与某人相处融洽。

literal.note_cn: 此处引申为“继续过下去”

chunks.ex_en: It's not easy to get along on so little money.
chunks.ex_cn: 靠这么点钱过日子不容易。

chunks.head: be rid of
chunks.note: be/get rid of sb/sth = 摆脱、甩掉某人或某物。
chunks.ex_en: I'm glad to be rid of that old car.
chunks.ex_cn: 能摆脱那辆破车我很高兴。

chunks.head: by this time
chunks.note: by this time = 到此刻为止，常用于叙述某个时间点已经发生的事。
chunks.ex_en: By this time everyone had gone home.
chunks.ex_cn: 到这时候，大家都已经回家了。

chunks.head: be tired of
chunks.note: be tired of sb/sth = 对某人某事感到厌烦；注意与 be tired(疲倦)区别。
chunks.ex_en: I'm tired of eating the same food every day.
chunks.ex_cn: 我厌倦了每天吃一样的饭。

chunks.head: a life of crime
chunks.note: a life of + 名词 = 过着…的生活(a life of luxury 奢华生活；a life of crime 犯罪生涯)。
chunks.ex_en: He was afraid his son would turn to a life of crime.
chunks.ex_cn: 他担心儿子会走上犯罪的道路。

chunks.head: stand by
chunks.note: stand by sb = 在困难时支持、不离不弃。另有“待命、准备”义(本章后文航海口令即此义,不同)。
chunks.ex_en: A true friend will stand by you in hard times.
chunks.ex_cn: 真正的朋友会在困难时支持你。

chunks.head: wear oneself out
chunks.note: wear sb out = 使某人筋疲力尽；反身形式指把自己累垮。

literal.note_cn: wear 的过去分词，此处非“穿戴”

chunks.ex_en: She wore herself out cleaning the whole house.
chunks.ex_cn: 她打扫了整栋房子，把自己累坏了。

chunks.head: it will never do
chunks.note: it will/would never do (to do sth) = 那可不行、行不通。此处 do 意为“行、合适”,非“做”。

literal.note_cn: 此处非“做”,指“可以、行得通”

chunks.ex_en: It will never do to be late for the interview.
chunks.ex_cn: 面试迟到可不行。

chunks.head: help oneself to
chunks.note: help oneself to sth = 自己动手取用(食物等);也可含“擅自拿走”之意。本章为后者(男孩们自取一块火种)。
chunks.ex_en: Please help yourself to some cake.
chunks.ex_cn: 请随便吃点蛋糕。

chunks.head: every now and then
chunks.note: = occasionally,表示不时地、间或地。也说 every now and again。
chunks.ex_en: Every now and then she looks out the window.
chunks.ex_cn: 她时不时往窗外看一眼。

chunks.head: lay in
chunks.note: lay in sth = 购入并储存(粮食、物资等)以备日后之需。
chunks.ex_en: They laid in plenty of food before the storm.
chunks.ex_cn: 暴风雨来临前，他们储备了大量食物。

chunks.head: come near doing
chunks.note: come near doing sth = 差一点就…(near 后接动名词)。

literal.note_cn: come near doing = 险些、几乎

chunks.ex_en: I came near forgetting his birthday.
chunks.ex_cn: 我差点忘了他的生日。

chunks.head: back and forth
chunks.note: 表示前后或来回反复移动。
chunks.ex_en: The dog ran back and forth along the fence.
chunks.ex_cn: 那只狗沿着篱笆来回跑。

chunks.head: deny oneself
chunks.gloss: 克制；舍不得(不让自己享有)
chunks.note: deny oneself sth = 不让自己享受某物、加以节制。
chunks.ex_en: He denied himself sweets to stay healthy.
chunks.ex_cn: 为了健康，他忍着不吃糖。

chunks.head: all by oneself
chunks.note: all by oneself = 完全独自一人(强调孤单)或全凭自己(强调独立完成)。
chunks.ex_en: The little boy built it all by himself.
chunks.ex_cn: 这个小男孩全靠自己把它搭好的。

chunks.head: get around
chunks.note: get around sth = 规避、避开(难题或规则)。本章两处均此义。
chunks.ex_en: There's no way to get around the rules.
chunks.ex_cn: 这些规定没办法回避。

chunks.head: run away
chunks.note: run away (from home) = 逃走、出走。本章两个男孩正是离家出走去当海盗。
chunks.ex_en: The frightened cat ran away.
chunks.ex_cn: 受惊的猫跑掉了。

chunks.head: at once
chunks.note: = immediately。另有“同时”义(all at once)。本章为“立刻”义。
chunks.ex_en: Come here at once!
chunks.ex_cn: 马上过来！

chunks.head: scores of
chunks.note: a score = 二十;scores of = 许许多多、成群成批的。

literal.note_cn: score 本义“二十”,复数虚指“大量”

chunks.ex_en: Scores of people came to the concert.
chunks.ex_cn: 许许多多的人来看演唱会。

chunks.head: to begin with
chunks.note: 两义:(1)起初、一开始;(2)首先(列举理由时)。本章为“起初”义。

literal.note_cn: 整体为习语,表“起初/首先”

chunks.ex_en: To begin with, we didn't have much money.
chunks.ex_cn: 起初，我们没多少钱。

chunks.head: dead men tell no tales
chunks.note: 谚语,意为把知情者除掉就不会走漏消息。tale 此处指“闲话、秘闻”。

literal.note_cn: 此处非“童话”,指“泄露的话”

chunks.ex_en: He silenced the witness, for dead men tell no tales.
chunks.ex_cn: 他杀人灭口，因为死人不会泄密。

chunks.head: let someone have it
chunks.note: 口语,let sb have it = 给某人狠狠一击、痛揍或痛骂一顿。

literal.note_cn: 此处 it 虚指“痛击”,非具体物

chunks.ex_en: If he says that again, I'll let him have it.
chunks.ex_cn: 他要是再那么说，我就狠狠教训他。

chunks.head: be all one to someone
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(“all careers were one to him”),故 card-only。it's all one to sb = 对某人来说都一样、毫不在意。

literal.note_cn: 此处指“没差别、都一回事”

chunks.ex_en: Tea or coffee, it's all one to me.
chunks.ex_cn: 茶还是咖啡，对我都一样。
